title: h5read
summary: Read dense numeric, logical, or string datasets from an HDF5 file.

gpu_support.notes: HDF5 parsing is host file I/O. GPU-resident arguments are gathered before native HDF5 access.

description: `h5read(filename, dataset)` reads a dataset from a native HDF5 file. `h5read(filename, dataset, start, count)` and `h5read(filename, dataset, start, count, stride)` read one-based hyperslab selections.
behaviors: Dense floating-point, integer, logical, and variable-length string datasets are mapped to RunMat numeric, logical, and string values.
Dataset dimensions are preserved while converting HDF5 row-major raw storage to RunMat column-major arrays.
Compound, reference, enum, fixed-array, and nested variable-length HDF5 types raise deterministic unsupported-type errors.
